description: Use this when someone asks about mountain passes in general, which passes are open, or wants the whole list: Washington's mountain passes in depth, and the passes on the roads out of it. Gives WithBy's verdict for Snoqualmie, Stevens, White and Blewett passes in one line each, then 12 other passes in WSDOT's words, seasonal closures marked, then the passes on the way out, each in its agency's words, with the time WithBy checked. Not for navigation or bookings.
name: passes_now
title: Mountain passes now
